headline: Steep GAAP loss persists but narrows versus last quarter
summary_short: Revenue was $122.4M, up 6.9% y/y but down 1.6% q/q, while diluted EPS of -$24.45 improved from -$38.25 in Q1 but reversed a year-ago profit of $32.60.
summary_long: Revenue was $122.4M, +6.9% y/y and -1.6% q/q. Gross profit was $81.6M (about 66.7% of revenue). Diluted EPS was -$24.45, versus -$38.25 in Q1 and +$32.60 a year ago. Net loss was $8,219.6M, narrower than Q1's $12,542.7M loss but a reversal from a $10,020.8M profit a year earlier. Cash fell to $1,711.8M from $2,207.2M q/q; long-term debt fell to $6,709.9M from $8,196.5M.
